title: Consolidation preview shows campaign intent without silent inheritance
source: Accepted keep-initiative-membership-current consolidation contract registered before its final guidance edit.
ground_truth: The full tally board has no initiatives. Sam asks only for a preview of consolidating the ready csv-export and config-file items into a new output-options campaign and explicitly withholds confirmation. The coordinator may inspect exact item definitions and current roadmap facts, then request the existing consolidation preview with the exact no-initiatives campaign intent. It must show the source-to-campaign effect and leave the board unchanged; a preview is not confirmation and must not consolidate, start or edit anything. No source membership can be inherited because none exists.

turns.human: Preview consolidating csv-export and config-file into a new output-options campaign. Show me the effects, but do not confirm, start, or change the board yet.
